credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: Glass jar containing Giolio d' Ore pigment powder (curry yellow) affixed with a handwritten label by Georgia O'Keeffe.  Handwritten in black ink, on a faded gummed paper label with a red border, are the words:  Giolio d' Ore - Milano. The black metal lid has slight abrasions and scratches and the jar of pigment is 1/2 full.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Addison Doty
materials: Pigment powder, glass, metal and paper
title: Paint Pigment, Giolio d' Ore
